Subject: Stonepine onboarding: vendor master info request

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the conversation yesterday. To get Stonepine set up in our vendor master and ensure POs route correctly, can you please complete the attached Redwood Vendor Onboarding Form and return the following items?

- Completed onboarding form (fillable PDF) — please include legal entity exactly as it appears on your incorporation docs.
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form) for Stonepine, Inc.
- Certificate of Incorporation or Articles of Organization (PDF).
- Remittance contact (name + email) and preferred PO routing address (AP email).
- Primary invoice acceptance method (email/portal) and any special PO requirements.
- Bank details for ACH (if you want ACH enabled) — bank routing/account can be redacted in email; we will request secure channel for full details.

If you prefer, you can return a single ZIP with the docs. Once we have these items we'll create the vendor record and route a test PO. Our AP team will reach out if they need any KYC follow-ups.

Target timeline: if you can send these by end of week (Friday PDT) we can have the vendor record provisioned within 5 business days.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim

Thanks for the quick turnaround on docs. Two quick clarifications before I push the vendor record through finance:

1) Tax classification — the W-9 indicates S-Corp here; can you confirm the EIN and whether Stonepine operates any US subsidiaries that should be separate vendor records? We want to avoid mixing different legal entities under a single vendor profile.

2) Legal/business address — the certificate lists 416 Harbor Drive but the form lists 410 Harbor Drive. Please confirm the correct registered office.

3) AP routing — we will set the PO route to ap@stonepine.com but our system requires a single inbox for automated ingestion. Can Maya confirm that ap@stonepine.com is monitored and will accept POs programmatically (any auto-replies are okay but we need acceptance).

If easier, we can run a short call (15 min) to confirm and I can capture notes for finance.
